pages.title: Saddle Up
pages.text: Start travelling with an animal; mounting is the goal, not a measured journey.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Approach a horse empty-handed and mount it until it trusts you. A saddle is needed to steer; this quest does not require a saddle or travel distance.

pages.title: Choose species-specific animal feed
pages.text: Cat Food, Dog Food, Horse Fodder and Chicken Feed serve different animals. Their tooltips describe taming, combat, running or jumping, and egg or feather production; there is no universal feed.
